import datetime

def calculate_time_to_event(event_time):
    current_time = datetime.datetime.now()
    event_time = datetime.datetime.strptime(event_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    time_to_event = event_time - current_time
    hours, remainder = divmod(time_to_event.seconds, 3600)
    minutes, _ = divmod(remainder, 60)
    return f"{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}"

event_time = "2024-05-15 12:30:00"
time_to_event = calculate_time_to_event(event_time)
